preconditions.description: The number of objects n must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(type_i in {0, 1} for type_i in types)
preconditions.description: Each object type must be either 0 (mountain) or 1 (hotel).
There must be at least one hotel among the objects.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= n for a_i in tracks)
preconditions.description: Each ski track index must be between 0 and n.

postconditions.description: The output must consist of the maximum path length k followed by the path indices.

postconditions.expression: len(path) == k and all(path[i] == path[i-1] + 1 for i in range(1, k))
postconditions.description: The path must consist of consecutive indices and have length k.
The last object in the path must be a hotel.
